title: extract_response consumes JmapResponse — multi-call batches require clone
description: extract_response<T>(resp: JmapResponse, call_id: &str) takes the response by value. Multi-call JMAP requests (the whole point of batching) require extracting multiple typed results from the same response. With the current signature, callers must clone the response before calling extract_response for all but the last invocation. Extension crates (jmap-mail-client, jmap-chat-client) will be the primary callers; every batched request they make will hit this. The signature should take &JmapResponse and clone the args Value internally, or return an iterator. This API will be hard to change once extension crates depend on it. Suggested fix: fn extract_response<T: DeserializeOwned>(resp: &JmapResponse, call_id: &str) -> Result<T, ClientError> — internal args.clone() is less expensive than forcing all callers to clone the entire response.
